source_tool_records.publication: Private execution audit source; never included in public bundle.

method: Pattern review of all extracted execution request arguments, directed review of source/authoring/repair/closeout calls, direct inspection of all selected process outputs, and independent current-state hashes and USD readback. Inter-agent message payloads and model reasoning are not review evidence.
process_output_review: All five outputs inspected. One includes own hinge controller code from its process command line; none exposes another case. A separate output lists five native hinge worker processes; this is recorded under the global harness scope.

asset_repair_chronology.description: First candidate and visual/source dependencies sealed after initial own probe.
One repair script authored and executed, changing the angular speed cap only.
Final root wrapper composed over repair1 and bindings copied.
Composed final-versus-repair content checked after removing autogenerated root-path documentation.
Both candidate seals rechecked at author closeout.

boundaries: This is an observational retained-tool audit, not an OS complete-access trace.
Current hashes cannot exclude transient modification followed by byte restoration.
Non-execution inter-agent message payloads are excluded; actual retained turn_context metadata is checked separately.
The pre-existing current receipt is preserved unchanged. No lost original audit bytes are reconstructed or claimed recovered.
